name: Google Nest Cam Indoor Wired 2nd gen (US)

radios.note: Dual-band Wi-Fi 802.11a/b/g/n/ac; Bluetooth Low Energy is used for setup.

matter.note: No Google page we found lists Matter for this camera.

apple_home.note: No Google page lists Apple Home; reviews say there is no HomeKit support, but that is not an official statement.

google_home.note: Set up in the Google Home app. Live video streams to Nest displays and Chromecast devices.

alexa.note: Live view on Echo Show screens by voice; wired cameras stop after 12 hours until you ask again. Google lists this model for motion and person announcements.

smartthings.note: No Google or Samsung page found.

home_assistant.note: Home Assistant's Google Nest integration lists this camera under WebRTC with motion and person events. Snapshot and stream-recording actions are not supported for WebRTC cameras.

hubRequired.note: Connects over Wi-Fi to the Google Home app; no bridge is listed.

localControl.note: Streams go through Google's cloud; no local-only mode is documented in the pages we saw.

cameraType.note: Google lists it for indoor use only.

power.note: 7.5 W adapter included; power stays on for 24/7 video history with a plan.

localStorage.note: No Google page we saw mentions local storage; event video is kept in Google's cloud.

subscription.value: Optional: longer event history and 24/7 recording
subscription.note: Google's spec page ties 24/7 history to a paid plan; retailers say 3 hours of event video are free. Plan names (Nest Aware / Google Home Premium) not confirmed from an official page.

summary: The Nest Cam (indoor, wired) 2nd gen is a plug-in indoor camera with 1080p HDR video and a 135 degree view, powered by a 10 ft USB-A cable. It works with Google Home and Nest displays, with Alexa for live view on Echo Show, and with Home Assistant's Nest integration. Apple Home and SmartThings support are not confirmed.
caveats: The 3rd gen indoor camera has different specs (2K, 152 degrees, USB-C); make sure you read the 2nd gen figures.
Home Assistant cannot snapshot or record this WebRTC camera through the integration.
Alexa live view on wired Nest cameras stops after 12 hours.
24/7 recording and longer history need a paid Google plan.
